text:
alice_ops: FYI NimbusHardware put two reserved racks on hold at customs in Rotterdam. Estimated delay 10-16 days pending paperwork. Need contingency plan for impacted Dedicated reservations.

ops-bot: partner-hold: partner=NimbusHardware reservations=[NIM-9920, NIM-9921] hold_reason=customs ETA_delta=+12d

ryan_partners: Which customer pools are those linked to? Any redline SLAs?

alice_ops: NIM-9920 -> three enterprise customers with committed capacity (north-eu region), NIM-9921 -> marketplace reserved buffer for burst credits. Contracts: two are SLA-backed.

isha_logistics: Customs flagged missing commercial invoice detail on tariff codes. Nimbus says they can provide corrected docs but lead time depends on broker backlog. They offered partial release of 1 rack if we sign off on re-export waiver.

dan_sales: For the enterprise customers, we have delivery SLAs tied to credits/penalties. Options: (A) activate hosted-burst routing to US/UK pools; (B) accept partial release + pay re-export waiver; (C) substitute with alternate SKU (lower mem) temporarily.

priya_pm: We need a crisp decision matrix for sales ops. Proposed immediate steps: 1) Notify affected customers w/ estimated delay + options; 2) If customer chooses hosted-burst, enable model-variant fallback and mark cost center; 3) If choose waiver, legal sign-off required.

matt_eng: Tech note: Hosted-burst into hosted pool OK, but pinned Dedicated configs will require routing override for region. KV cache warming + prefetch recommended to avoid latency spikes. We should prepare an automated feature-flag toggle.

ryan_partners: Can Nimbus accelerate if we provide a broker contact or pay express release? Any cost figures?

isha_logistics: Nimbus quoted ~€6.5k for broker expedited handling and re-export waiver fee. Partial release (1 of 2 racks) possible immediately if we accept waiver. Full replacement ETA 3 weeks if we refuse.

dan_sales: If we accept partial release, which customers get priority? Suggest cust-E (enterprise, high SLA) first, then cust-F, cust-G. Marketplace buffer can cover trials.

priya_pm: I'll assemble comm templates: "we're working with our hardware partner to expedite; you can opt into hosted-burst (no downtime), accept partial swap, or wait for replacement". Need legal language for waiver acceptance.

legal-bot: Legal note: re-export waiver needs OOO sign-off from contracts. We can do expedited e-sign but must track cost pass-through to customer if required.

alice_ops: Quick ask: do we have available marketplace credits or partner spots this week for burst?

matt_eng: We have limited marketplace burst capacity in eu-west this week: ~120 vGPU hours/day. Enough to cover ~48h per enterprise customer at low concurrency. For longer, costs escalate.

ryan_partners: Let's build a short playbook and a matrix for customer offers. I'll coordinate with Nimbus on who pays the €6.5k if we accept partial release.

isha_logistics: Nimbus proposes shared cost model: we absorb €3k, they absorb €3.5k if we accept partial release and commit not to publicize the hold for 30 days.

dan_sales: Customers usually prefer no service disruption. Offer A: immediate hosted-burst (we cover up to €2k each) + prorated credit. Offer B: accept partial release with shared fee and promise replacement in 3 weeks. Offer C: swap to lower SKU with temporary discount.

priya_pm: Drafting playbook: TOC -> Incident summary; Priority customer list; Offer matrix; Ops runbook (matt); Logistics negotiation points (isha); Legal approvals; Communication templates (dan).

matt_eng: Runbook highlights: 1) Toggle routing override; 2) Canary to 5% traffic; 3) Warm KV cache, prefetch commons; 4) Monitor latency and token error rates; 5) Revert if degraded. I'll add exact commands.

alice_ops: Who can approve emergency spend? Ops can approve up to €5k; above that needs finance + contracts. We'll prepare approval sheet.

ops-bot: doc-created: /playbooks/nimbus-customs-contingency-draft by priya_pm

ryan_partners: Next steps: Isha push for partial release + cost split; Alice notify customers with options; Priya post playbook and templates; Matt prepare runbook + FF toggle; Dan prepare tailored comms for top 3. Sync in 3 hours.

isha_logistics: Update 2.5h later -> Nimbus confirmed partial release for 1 rack if we sign waiver; they accept shared cost model but need signed LOI. They also submitted corrected invoices for customs to attempt full release in 10 days.

dan_sales: Given that, I'll contact cust-E offering hosted-burst (48h) immediately and option to take partial release when available. I'll propose we cover up to €2k and ask cust-E for consent to share remaining cost if they'd rather have guaranteed on-prem latency.

priya_pm: Playbook posted. Please review and flag missing pieces.

matt_eng: Reviewed and added the feature-flag CLI snippet and health-check thresholds. One more: add a note about model-variant labeling for lower SKU to avoid confusion.

alice_ops: Thanks team. Ryan please secure the LOI for the waiver and loop in contracts. We'll send initial customer comms after legal checks.

ops-bot: thread-closed: pending LOI and customer ack
